column1: # Dolphin Rt:Core R - options. F: submenu, key, LABEL, description. C: key, value, label, overrides (-C Section.Key=Value;...)

column5: Apply the per-game .ini fixes shipped with the core.
Stick layout used by the controller profiles.
Wii only. How the Wiimote is held.
Button combo that closes the game cleanly.
Render scale. 1x is native (640x480); higher is much heavier.
How the picture is fitted to the screen.
Stretch 4:3 games to 16:9 without distortion (can glitch some games).
Sharper textures at an angle. Costs GPU time.
Smooth every texture, even ones the game wants blocky.
Smooths edges. Very heavy on this GPU.
Wait for the screen refresh (removes tearing, can lower FPS).
How shaders are built when a game first needs them.
Needed by some effects (e.g. lens flares); slows games down.
Emulated CPU speed. Below 1x can speed up heavy games (and desync some).
Run CPU and GPU emulation on separate threads.
Needed by a few games; slower.
On = fast high-level audio. Off = accurate but very heavy.
How Dolphin opens its window. Auto picks Wayland, then X11 if this build has them, else the framebuffer.
